operations.trigger_summary: Package a prepared version-matched source as a deterministic SpaceClaim script archive.
Audit a SpaceClaim script archive for structure, API markers, unsafe paths, and forbidden recorded aliases.
Validate the structure and internal invariants of one declared SpaceClaim runtime report on the host.
Compare one structurally valid runtime report with one expected measurement contract on the host.
Compare declared forward and native-reopen geometry measurements and names on the host.

Use before any desktop control when the task scope or authorization record may have changed.
Use when more than one application window or session could receive the next action.
Use after a unique target session is confirmed and before active visual or script control.
Use when a no-baseline execution requires a clean document entry state.
Use when a run must operate on an existing baseline without mutating the baseline path.
Use immediately before script loading/execution when document focus may have changed.
Use before creating a runtime report, native model, or other run output.
Use after entry/document/output gates pass and the session is idle.
Use only after authorization, session, document, and loaded-script gates are satisfied.
Use after one execution event is correlated and no second run may start.
Use after an execution event when planned and actual script bytes may differ.
Use when a run has failed/stopped and logs, events, and state are available.
Use after a critical assertion failure and before any native save has begun.
Use only after the current root Part and every supplied critical check match the accepted run.
Use after EX-12 has produced an ordered earliest_failure record.
Use when one failing call is identified and the target version signature is available.
Use when one path parse, escape, Unicode, or encoding failure is located.
Use when one selection predicate is ambiguous or selected the wrong candidate.
Use when one consumer is proven to use a pre-mutation body/face/edge collection.
Use after a Boolean completed and results are observable but the wrong result member was selected.
Use when one defect and one approved repair mode are known; not a generic repair search.
Use when one desired name collides with an existing object and ownership/strategy are known.
Use when one state mismatch is located and expected state is known.
Use when failure is isolated to one path, format, permission, or other declared condition.
Use only when a failed artifact is proven run-owned and is not baseline/evidence.
Use after caller restored clean entry and loaded corrected artifact.
Use when the current root Part is resolved and body enumeration or an expected body count must be checked.
Use when one current body is resolved and its face collection or expected face count must be checked.
Use when one current body is resolved and its edge collection or expected edge count must be checked.
Use when a finite object collection, expected count, and explicit or unambiguous object scope are available.
Use when the current body, frame, unit, and any expected bounding-box tolerance are explicit.
Use when the current body, volume unit, and any expected value or tolerance are explicit.
Use when the current body, area unit, and any expected value or tolerance are explicit.
Use when the current body/face, requested property, unit, and center frame requirement are explicit.
Use when the current body/face identity is resolved and the underlying face type must be reported.
Use when a current cylinder face and unit are explicit; preserve manual review for unavailable axes or non-exact rotated spans.
Use when a current cone face, unit, and angle convention are explicit; preserve manual review for unresolved span precision.
Use when the current torus face and unit are resolved and any intended fillet relation is explicitly declared.
Use when the live root, positions, rule, and tolerance are supplied; do not infer CAD feature locations.
Use when exactly one current target identity and its expected name are available.
Use when the current group and complete expected member identities are resolved in the same root scope.
Use after an output file exists at an authorized absolute regular path and its expected digest is known.
Use after a native .scdoc save when the file digest, save record, and run reference are available for checking.
Use when the target document is uniquely controllable and the unsaved-change choice is explicit and authorized.
Use when the native file is readable and the target session is idle, unique, and free of blocking dialogs.
Use when a measured native-reopen observation, expected value, artifact SHA-256, and any tolerance are available.
Use when the active model, export format/path, options, and independent identity gates are explicit.
Use when a measured reimport observation, expected value, source SHA-256, and any tolerance are available.
Use before GUI selection, navigation, or screenshot actions when the target window state is observable.
Use when a maximized unobstructed viewport is available and navigation controls need session-specific calibration.
Use when the target is visible, unique under the filter, and pre-highlight identifies the intended object.
Use when the target, current selection set, and Ctrl+left or equivalent toggle mapping are known.
Use when the target edge and loop are identifiable and double-click or an equivalent loop command is calibrated.
Use when the body is visible, uniquely identified, and triple-click or an equivalent body-selection route is verified.
Use when at least two candidates overlap at the known cursor position and candidate cycling is supported.
Use in an interactive idle session when a single clear-selection control is calibrated for the current mode.
Use when the screen region, selection filter, and current left-to-right/right-to-left rule are known.
Use when the context target and focus are explicit and a stationary right click is controllable.
Use when the viewport is unobstructed, no geometry tool is active, and middle-drag or Spin is calibrated.
Use when the viewport is unobstructed, no geometry tool is active, and Shift+middle-drag or Pan is calibrated.
Use when the viewport is unobstructed, no geometry tool is active, and Ctrl+middle-drag or Zoom is calibrated.
Use when the cursor is over the viewport and wheel direction/step behavior is calibrated in the session.
Use when the target range is explicit, the fit command is available, and no dialog blocks the viewport.
Use when the target session is unique and idle and one current Home definition is known.
Use when the standard direction/frame are explicit and the View control is visible in the unique target session.
Use when the reference normal, view side, side convention, and Plan/Snap control are available.
Use when the target feature and visibility goal are explicit and any camera adjustment is authorized.
Use when both views and the feature are available and projection or scale differences are explicitly considered.
Use when the target feature, current view, and observed obstruction or uncertainty can be located.
Use when the target view is confirmed, the viewport is sufficiently unobstructed, and the screenshot destination is authorized.
